from rcb_hb import Session
import numpy as np, mujoco
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=s.data
  self.kd=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
  self.q0=self.d.qpos.copy()
  self.targets=np.zeros(self.m.nu)
  for i in range(self.m.nu):
   j=self.m.actuator_trnid[i,0]
   self.targets[i]=self.d.qpos[self.m.jnt_qposadr[j]] if self.m.actuator_trntype[i]==0 else self.d.ten_length[j]
  self.qadr=np.array([self.m.jnt_qposadr[self.m.actuator_trnid[i,0]] for i in range(self.m.nu)])
  self.vadr=np.array([self.m.jnt_dofadr[self.m.actuator_trnid[i,0]] for i in range(self.m.nu)])
  self.arms=[np.array([11,12,13,14,15,21,22]),np.array([16,17,18,19,20,41,42])]
  self.palms=[19,48]
  self.rot0=[self.d.xmat[b].reshape(3,3).copy() for b in self.palms]
 def ik(self,side,pos,rot=None,local=np.array([0,0,.045])):
  # solve on separate kinematic data; include wrist joints, constrain redundant posture
  ids=self.arms[side];qa=self.qadr[ids];va=self.vadr[ids];b=self.palms[side]
  k=self.kd;k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos
  k.qpos[qa]=self.targets[ids]
  lo,hi=self.m.actuator_ctrlrange[ids].T
  for it in range(8):
   mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,k);mujoco.mj_comPos(self.m,k)
   R=k.xmat[b].reshape(3,3);pt=k.xpos[b]+R@local
   jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));jr=jp.copy();mujoco.mj_jac(self.m,k,jp,jr,pt,b)
   ep=np.asarray(pos)-pt
   if rot is None:
    J=jp[:,va];err=ep
   else:
    er=Rotation.from_matrix(rot@R.T).as_rotvec()
    J=np.concatenate([jp[:,va],.25*jr[:,va]]);err=np.r_[ep,.25*er]
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+.0002*np.eye(len(err)),err)
   k.qpos[qa]=np.clip(k.qpos[qa]+np.clip(dq,-.15,.15),lo,hi)
  self.targets[ids]=k.qpos[qa]
 def fingers(self,side,close=0,thumb=.3):
  off=21+20*side
  # Thumb opposable then proximal flexion, four fingers curling down
  self.targets[off+2:off+7]=[.2,thumb,0,.2,.4*close]
  for a in [8,11,14,18]:self.targets[off+a]=1.1*close
  for a in [9,12,15,19]:self.targets[off+a]=2.0*close
  for a in [7,10,13,17]:self.targets[off+a]=0
  self.targets[off+16]=.1*close
 def action(self,balance=True,grav=True):
  q=self.targets.copy()
  if grav:
   for i in range(21): q[i]+=self.d.qfrc_bias[self.vadr[i]]/self.m.actuator_gainprm[i,0]
  if balance:
   # desired root pitch zero, feet fixed; ankle torques stabilise torso
   pitch=np.arctan2(self.d.xmat[1].reshape(3,3)[0,2],self.d.xmat[1].reshape(3,3)[2,2])
   roll=np.arctan2(-self.d.xmat[1].reshape(3,3)[1,2],self.d.xmat[1].reshape(3,3)[2,2])
   q[[4,9]]+=-.7*pitch-.10*self.d.qvel[4]
   q[[1,6]]+=.4*roll+.04*self.d.qvel[3]
  return np.clip(self.s.low.task.normalize_action(q),-1,1)
 def point(self,side,local=np.array([0,0,.045])):
  b=self.palms[side];return self.d.xpos[b]+self.d.xmat[b].reshape(3,3)@local

def metric(s):
 d=s.data;r=s.low.robot
 p=d.site_xpos
 da=np.linalg.norm(p[12]-p[9]);db=np.linalg.norm(p[11]-p[10])
 hand=min(np.linalg.norm(p[7]-p[9]),np.linalg.norm(p[8]-p[10]))
 h=min(p[9,2],p[10,2]);u=r.torso_upright();v=np.linalg.norm(r.center_of_mass_velocity())
 # smooth measures of both multiplicative groups
 stand=np.clip((r.head_height()-1.3)/.3,0,1)*np.clip(u,0,1)*np.exp(-v*v)
 ins=(np.exp(-(da/.15)**2)+np.exp(-(db/.15)**2))/2
 height=np.clip((h-.9)/.2,0,1)
 near=np.exp(-(hand/.25)**2)
 return (.5*stand+.5*ins)*(.5*height+.5*near),[da,db,h,hand,u,v]
